Now, a recursive function is one that calls itself within its own code. This is used to solve problems that can be broken down into smaller, similar problems. Like calculating factorial of a number. The function calls itself with a reduced value until it reaches the base case.

The main difference is that recursive functions call themselves, leading to repeated execution of the same function with different parameters. This can lead to more concise code but also risks stack overflow if not
